instruction: Turn on Chrome's 'Do Not Track' setting to safeguard my privacy while browsing.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"enable_do_not_track":false}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Do Not Track' in Chrome privacy settings. The evaluator uses the existing get_enable_do_not_track getter to check the Preferences file and verify that enable_do_not_track is set to true. Custom metric function check_do_not_track__daf0df3998e3903555e9d178c5d32cd7 compares the result against expected value 'true'.

Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns 'true'/'false' string, metric compares string with expected['expected']
Instruction coverage is complete: task asks to enable Do Not Track, evaluator verifies enable_do_not_track is set to true
